initial_requirements: Developers building multi-agent systems need an expanded agentMom framework that provides reusable communication capabilities for agents and their conversations. Agents should be able to communicate with one recipient, selected groups, or all agents on a local network, join and leave communication groups, and choose whether messages require protection. The new framework must remain usable with applications based on the existing agentMom environment.
